name: Reverse-Scrolling Columns
description: A three column gallery where the outer columns glide upward against the scroll direction, driven entirely by the native CSS animation-timeline scroll() function. No JavaScript, no observers, graceful static fallback.
usage: Include styles.css, wrap three .rsc-column divs in one .rsc-columns container and add .rsc-reverse to the first and third. Fill each column with .rsc-item figures and make every column taller than the viewport so the counter-scroll has room to travel.
